- From thread: Ops (view A) means date-only changes are REBOOKED at night when AMENDED does not update the carrier portal.

- From thread: Ops (view A) means an option that is not safe at night because it does not push the date to the carrier portal.

- From thread: Finance means the business outcome must avoid invoicing the same shipment twice.
